patch.value: Correct the closeout record: the upstream template SDK defect is mitigated, not fixed

Tracks gh:unbraind/pm-presets#184 (filed 2026-10-31, missed by the blind issue watch). The closeout of the upstream-template-defect item marked it delivered with PR #170 and listed it under CHANGELOG 'Fixed', but PR #170 only ships the package's fail-closed adapter mitigation: the host defects remain on upstream main (parseStoredTemplateOptions still assigns arbitrary accepted keys by indexed assignment into normalized, builtinTemplateDocument still indexes BUILTIN_TEMPLATES without an own-property check, and resolveTypeSynonym still indexes the ordinary-object synonym table — re-verified on upstream main 2026-11-02). The canonical item itself says the upstream follow-up stays open and requires host SDK/CLI own-key regression coverage before revisiting those refusals. Action: record a follow-up here that keeps the upstream fix open (watch upstream releases for own-key checks in template parsing and type synonyms), and correct the CHANGELOG wording from 'Fixed' to 'Mitigated (package-side)' so consumers do not read the host defect as repaired.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Main still attributes the upstream defect to adapter PR 170. Plan: append a status correction preserving all native history, retain compatibility refusals, and add a real nongit SDK tracker regression that checks unresolved upstream work cannot be emitted as Fixed by the closeout workflow.

A generic upstream:unresolved gate will reject done-role closure before closeout changelog generation.

The explicit upstream:unresolved marker separately guards automatic completion; no tagged snapshots or existing audit records are edited. The first native reopen attempt rejected unsupported timestamp unsets without changing state; the supported status transition cleared completion fields automatically.

All current-head CI gates are green, including 348/348 tests in each npm/Bun full release gate and both Node matrix jobs. value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Confirmed review finding PRRT_kwDOSp_1PM60iOzn with a real SDK tracker and disposable Git history: an untagged package version fails closeout with MISSING_REQUESTED_RELEASE. The hook now explicitly suppresses pending-release generation. CI delegates exact-byte checks to the pinned generator in either legitimate historical or prepared-release mode. Publication additionally requires the original strict release checker via prepublishOnly; actual release workflow generation/check semantics remain strict. The regression accepts historical closeouts, rejects them for publication, accepts prepared release notes, and rejects corrupted artifacts without rewriting them.

The fixture uses fixed historical completion/tag timestamps, explicit synthetic Git identity, and scrubbed credential/Git-routing variables. The previously pushed head passed all CI, but this code fix requires fresh exact-head CI and re-review. Releasing the claim pending those checks.
